title: Network page header, section hints and calendar chip time

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-21 in the project thread: 'Evolve all these cards and the page design'.

detail: Second half of the Network page redesign (cards shipped in LIVE-1230). The header gains a Network eyebrow and a counts line, each section a one-line hint, Up next a Full calendar jump link, and the shared calendar chips lead with a bolder time line.

verify.note: Fails when the eyebrow, the Full calendar link or the calendar chip hook goes away.
